## Winter Naked Barley 2020

During 2020 we planted three winter barley trials, AMBA its a set of Experimental cover lines coming from Oregon state university, FRT its a set of Naked Barley lines coming from OREI Naked Barley, and HB its a subset of Naked Barley that survived from the previous year fall Diversity panel (DIV), and its checks.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Set up code
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(asreml)
  library(dplyr)
  library(gt)
  library(janitor)
})

AMBA<-openxlsx::read.xlsx("Fildbooks/2020/2020 AMBA LTT Field book.xlsx")

AMBA<- AMBA %>% janitor::clean_names()

AMBA$tw_b<-AMBA$test_weight_kg_hl/1.247

AMBA$y_g_sqm<-((AMBA$weight_kg*((100-AMBA$moisture)/88))*1000)/(1.524*3.63)
AMBA$Bu_ac<-((AMBA$y_g_sqm/454)*4046.86)/60

AMBA<-AMBA[order(AMBA$col, AMBA$row),]
AMBA<-AMBA[,c(1,3:5, 7, 26, 28)]
AMBA$exp<-"AMBA"
AMBA$tw_b[AMBA$tw_b<20]<-NA
AMBA$Bu_ac[AMBA$Bu_ac<20]<-NA
FRT<-openxlsx::read.xlsx("Fildbooks/2020/2020 FRT MAD Fieldbook.xlsx")

FRT<- FRT %>% janitor::clean_names()

FRT$tw_b<-FRT$test_weight_kg_hetolitre/1.247
FRT$y_g_sqm<-((FRT$weight_kg*((100-FRT$moisture)/88))*1000)/(1.524*3.63)
FRT$Bu_ac<-((FRT$y_g_sqm/454)*4046.86)/60

FRT<-FRT[order(FRT$col, FRT$row),]
FRT<-FRT[,c(1,3:5, 7, 31, 33)]
FRT$exp<-"FRT"
FRT$tw_b[FRT$tw_b<20]<-NA
FRT$Bu_ac[FRT$Bu_ac<20]<-NA

HB<-openxlsx::read.xlsx("Fildbooks/2020/2020 HB MAD Fieldbook.xlsx")

HB<- HB%>% janitor::clean_names()
HB$tw_b<-HB$test_weight_kg_hl/1.247
HB$y_g_sqm<-((HB$plot_weight_kg*((100-HB$moisture_percent)/88))*1000)/(1.524*3.63)
HB$Bu_ac<-((HB$y_g_sqm/454)*4046.86)/60

HB<- HB[order(HB$col, HB$row),]
HB<-HB[,c(1,3:5, 7, 32, 34)]
HB$exp<-"HB"
HB$tw_b[HB$tw_b<20]<-NA
HB$Bu_ac[HB$Bu_ac<20]<-NA
library(asreml)

asreml.options(maxit=100,extra=10) 
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| label: Test weight AMBA Mixed Model

AMBA$col<-as.factor(AMBA$col)
AMBA$row<-as.factor(AMBA$row)
AMBA$rep<-as.factor(AMBA$rep)
#AMBA$ib<-as.factor(AMBA$ib)
AMBA$genotype<-as.factor(AMBA$genotype)

AMBA[AMBA$plot==13249, "tw_b"]<-NA
AMBA[AMBA$plot==13239, "tw_b"]<-NA
tw_amba <- asreml(fixed = AMBA$tw_b ~ genotype,
              random = ~ rep,
              residuals = ~ ar1(col):ar1(row),
              data = AMBA, workspace = 16e8)
tw_amba <- update.asreml(tw_amba)

# Variance components
vc <- summary(tw_amba)$varcomp |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Component")

# Residuals
res <- data.frame(plot = AMBA$plot, e = tw_amba$residuals)
res$z <- as.numeric(scale(res$e))
worst_hi <- res$plot[which.max(res$e)]
worst_lo <- res$plot[which.min(res$e)]
n_out <- sum(abs(res$z) > 3)

# BLUEs
pred_tw_amba <- predict(tw_amba, classify = "genotype", workspace = 16e8, maxiter = 100)
BLUES_tw_amba <- pred_tw_amba$pvals |>
  dplyr::select(genotype, predicted.value, std.error) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(predicted.value))

top    <- BLUES_tw_amba[1, ]
bottom <- BLUES_tw_amba[nrow(BLUES_tw_amba), ]
```

```{r}
#| label: Residuals plot TW AMBA
#| warning: true
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: Residual diagnostics from the spatial model.

plot(tw_amba)
```

```{r}
#| label: Variance componenets TW AMABA
#| warning: true
#| include: false
#| echo: false
vc |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(where(is.numeric), decimals = 3)
```

```{r}
#| warning: true
#| echo: false
#| label: BLUES TW AMBA
BLUES_tw_amba |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "TW AMBA", subtitle = "lb/bushel") |>
  cols_label(genotype = "Genotype",
             predicted.value = "TW (lb/B)",
             std.error = "S.E.") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(predicted.value, std.error), decimals = 2)|>
  tab_options(table.width = pct(50),
              table.align = "center",
              heading.align = "center")
```
